grammar: T ::= S | (T T); all fully parenthesized ordered binary trees with exactly rootLeaves leaves.
rewrite: (((S x) y) z) -> ((x z) (y z)) at any single matching occurrence.
addresses: Root is empty string; 0 descends left/function,1 right/argument. Preorder is the lexicographic address order.
historyIdentity: Each ordered sequence of redex occurrence addresses is a separate history, even when states merge.
stopping: Stop at a redex-free normal form; otherwise at zero remaining steps use horizon. An edge to more than leafCap leaves stops as leaf_limit, recording that actual successor.
scope: Finite bounded histories only. Neither cutoff certifies divergence, non-normalization or nonuniversality.
